notes: Object insert through has_species, the inverse of in_genus. "A species belongs to the family of its genus" and "Pongo is in Hominidae" are one class axiom over in_family. w1 keeps the closed list of three living orangutan species and does not reopen it, while the edit adds a new, distinct living species; the record's w2 chain says it is none of the listed ones, so every entity is distinct and w1 is an exception (as in physics-insert-0003 and the people, literature_arts and technology inserts). Real problem: w1's 'yes' to the 'only' question is a stale closed claim the insert contradicts. (Changed in verification 2026-10-30: the earlier file left the new name out of distinct so w1 could pass.) "Hominidae are apes" is written through a class of the family individual (ApeFamily), not as "in_family value hominidae ⊑ Ape": with that form reason.py's q0 probe (the same class expression) was not reported as entailed though HermiT entails it (owlready2 equivalent-class probe issue). Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

background.pongo_family: in_genus value pongo ⊑ in_family value hominidae
